scope: Secrets, backups and edge: post-breach rotation, R2 backup key split and lock, rs-console secret split, Cloudflare Access for fbc-api, R2 CORS, vaultwarden and memtrade backups, stray secret files, stale checkouts, OpenSearch/Alertmanager LAN exposure.

findings.title: The coordinator's master secrets go to every container that reads secrets.env; live, the internet-facing rs-console holds the vault key, worker-token secret and coordinator DB URL
findings.location: trackers/facebook/deploy/docker-compose.console.yml:29-30; deploy/docker-compose.fleetd.yml:52,61; deploy/docker-compose.messenger.yml:37; deploy/docker-compose.poster.yml:36; configs/secrets.env.example:111-121; live container rs-console on 10.10.10.73
findings.proposed_fix: Split secrets.env: secrets.coordinator.env (vault key, token secret, admin token, DB URL) for the coordinator only; a console file holding RS_CONSOLE_TOKEN plus the admin token it forwards with; a workers' file. Then rotate RS_VAULT_KEY (re-encrypt) and RS_WORKER_TOKEN_SECRET. Recreating the console is not a login; worker recreation is, so plan that rotation with the owner.
findings.regression_test: A test in rs_console or scripts/tests that parses every deploy/*.yml and fails if a service other than the coordinator env_files a file listed as coordinator-only.

findings.title: check-secrets.sh misses the files .gitignore protects as credentials and unquoted or lowercase secret values
findings.proposed_fix: Mirror the .gitignore credential block. Add an unquoted KEY=value rule, case-insensitive matching, and URL-credential and syt_ patterns.
findings.regression_test: Extend scripts/tests/test-check-secrets.sh with each missed case.

findings.title: One credential can both read and delete every prod DB backup; no object lock or versioning, and the R2 keys were in the 2026-10-21 Railway env exposure
findings.location: backup/backup.sh:97-111; backup/Dockerfile:15; infra/terraform/environments/experiment-backups/main.tf:33-36,54-61,96-104; docs/backups-cloud-runbook.md:11-17; Railway pg-r2-backup (3224fca5-f6cc-47f9-8dba-6b1db81fda1c) vars R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID / R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: confirm or rotate the backup R2 key now. Then work through runbook steps 1-3: import recycle-db-backup into Terraform with prevent_destroy; give the cron a PutObject-only token and set BACKUP_KEEP=0 so the bucket lifecycle (30 d) handles retention; enable an R2 bucket lock with retention of at least 30 days.
findings.regression_test: After the change, a DeleteObject with the cron's token returns 403. Run terraform plan on experiment-backups: it shows the lock and lifecycle on recycle-db-backup and no drift.

findings.title: facebook-tracker Postgres password never rotated after the 2026-10-21 Railway env-var breach, and it is on a public TCP proxy
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: plan a coordinated rotation. Regenerate in the dashboard, then update the homelab containers' DSN in one batch. Note that updating worker containers means restarts, which are Facebook logins, so do it within a single planned deploy, or first move worker DB access behind rs_console so only the coordinator/console need the new DSN. If the TCP proxy isn't needed, remove it, or restrict it until the rotation is done.
findings.regression_test: After rotation: psql with the old password via the proxy must fail (by fingerprint, no value printed); audit log shows DatabasePassword.regenerated for project ca12c55b.

findings.title: Vaultwarden (password.jinhu.us) volume has no backups recorded
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: enable Railway volume backups on the vaultwarden volume, or add an encrypted export to R2. Confirm that SIGNUPS_ALLOWED is false and that an ADMIN_TOKEN policy is intended.
findings.regression_test: Audit log shows Backup.created for project 1f5ba707 daily.

findings.title: [cross-lane] fbc-api.recycleservers.com is not behind Cloudflare Access; only the console bearer guards relogin/session endpoints
findings.location: fbc-api.recycleservers.com (zone recycleservers.com); docs claim at AGENTS.md:72, trackers/facebook/AGENTS.md:43, apps/backend/src/routes/coordinator.ts:37-43
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: confirm in the Zero Trust dashboard whether an Access app exists for fbc-api.recycleservers.com; if absent or set to Bypass, create a self-hosted app with a Service Auth policy for the ERP's service token (keep /healthz bypass if a monitor needs it). If public exposure is intended, correct AGENTS.md and coordinator.ts comments.
findings.regression_test: Scheduled probe: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://fbc-api.recycleservers.com/v1/workers must be 302/403 from Access (cf-access headers or cloudflareaccess.com Location), never the origin's 401 JSON.

findings.title: R2 attachments CORS fix (INF-02) was committed but never applied: live bucket allows only inventory.recycleservers.com
findings.location: R2 bucket recycle-erp-attachments CORS; infra/terraform/environments/prod/main.tf:32-36; tfstate key prod/terraform.tfstate last written 2026-06-19T14:13:52Z
findings.proposed_fix: Owner runs terraform plan/apply in infra/terraform/environments/prod with the Cloudflare + R2 state credentials; expect a 1-resource in-place update to cloudflare_r2_bucket_cors.attachments. Add a post-apply curl check with each Origin.
findings.regression_test: curl -sI -H 'Origin: https://inventory-prod.recycleservers.com' https://static.recycleservers.com/<known object> | grep -i access-control-allow-origin, for each origin in prod/main.tf.

findings.title: 406 stale hourly full-DB dumps from June–July sit at the backup bucket root forever
findings.location: R2 bucket recycle-db-backup, keys recycle_erp_20260614T180401Z.dump.gz … recycle_erp_20260704T010001Z.dump.gz
findings.proposed_fix: Owner decides retention; delete the root-level recycle_erp_2026*.dump.gz objects or move one to cold storage, and add a lifecycle rule for the root prefix.
findings.regression_test: r2 object list on recycle-db-backup shows no keys outside railway-erp/.

findings.title: Terraform does not describe the live backup and dev buckets; experiment-backups code would create a third bucket
findings.location: infra/terraform/environments/experiment-backups/main.tf:33-104; tfstate keys experiment-backups (181 bytes = empty) and experiment-attachments-dev (no code in repo); docs/deployment-railway-cloudflare-backups.md:104-116
findings.proposed_fix: Import recycle-db-backup (and attachments-dev) into a managed environment, delete experiment-backups and the orphan state key, and fix or remove the stale doc section.
findings.regression_test: terraform plan per environment shows no changes after import.

findings.title: Retired Worker recycle-erp-experiment is still live on workers.dev and is wrangler.toml's default target
findings.proposed_fix: Owner deletes the recycle-erp-experiment Worker. Rename the top-level name to something deploy.sh refuses, or make deploy.sh the only documented path (it always passes --env).

findings.title: ERP Workers have no observability, and deployed versions carry no commit tag
findings.location: deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.toml (no [observability]); deploy/cloudflare/deploy.sh:43; live settings recycle-erp-prod/dev observability=null
findings.proposed_fix: Add [observability] enabled=true (with a sampling rate) to wrangler.toml, and pass --tag ${GITHUB_SHA::8} --message "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" to wrangler deploy in deploy.sh.
findings.regression_test: After the next deploy, `wrangler deployments list --env prod` shows the commit sha as the tag.

findings.title: Secrets backup trackers/reddit/scripts/secrets.env.bak-20261022-192641 sits untracked and not gitignored in the main checkout
findings.proposed_fix: Change .gitignore:9 to 'secrets.env*' with '!secrets.env.example'. Owner: delete the .bak once the rotation is confirmed complete.
findings.regression_test: git check-ignore trackers/reddit/scripts/secrets.env.bak-x prints a match.

findings.title: Stale deployable checkouts: five ERP clones at v1.261-1.268, one linked to Railway production, and the legacy facebook_tracker clone with a working deploy.sh
findings.proposed_fix: Owner decision: move the five ~/Projects/recycle_servers/recycle_servres_erp* clones, recycle_servers_v2/recycle_servres_erp-{handfish,lancetfish}, and (after B5-01/02/03 are unloaded) ~/Projects/recycle_servers/facebook_tracker into ~/Projects/_archive with a README, and `railway unlink` the handfish path. Optionally add an `origin/main` ancestry guard to deploy/cloudflare/deploy.sh (other lane's file).
findings.regression_test: No path under ~/Projects outside the ERP main clone/worktrees has deploy/cloudflare/deploy.sh; ~/.railway/config.json has no production link to a non-worktree checkout.

findings.title: [cross-lane] memtrade, the far side of the /api/wechat-market/push contract, has no commits and no backup
findings.location: ~/Projects/wehat_ai/memtrade (.git with zero commits; tmutil: no destinations configured)
findings.proposed_fix: Make an initial commit and push to a private remote (the three token files are 0600 and must be in .gitignore first; verify), and back up data/ (or point R2 backup at it).
findings.regression_test: `git -C ~/Projects/wehat_ai/memtrade log -1` succeeds and `git status --short` does not list src/.

findings.title: Facebook session cookie files in the legacy checkout are world-readable (0644)
findings.proposed_fix: chmod 600 those files (or remove them when the checkout is archived per B5-04). Owner action since it touches a sessions directory.

findings.title: Unauthenticated HTTP servers on 0.0.0.0 with the macOS firewall off serve review docs and WeChat market reports to the whole LAN
findings.location: launchd com.jinhu.archify-previews (python3 -m http.server 8800 --bind 0.0.0.0, ~/archify-previews) and com.wehatai.memtrade-web (node src/cli.ts serve, *:8780)
findings.proposed_fix: Bind to the VPN/LAN interface the owner uses or put a basic-auth/allowlist in front; keep sensitive reviews out of ~/archify-previews; enable the application firewall.
findings.regression_test: From another LAN host, curl http://<mac>:8800/ returns 401/connection refused unless from the allowlisted address.

findings.title: fbmonitor watchdog pkills every chrome-headless-shell on the Mac
findings.proposed_fix: Goes away with unloading the watchdog per B5-01; otherwise kill only descendants of the agent's pid.
